vacios.diario: This is where you'll keep what God is doing in your life.
vacios.oraciones: Once you write your first request, it will appear here.
vacios.memorial: This is where you'll remember the prayers God has answered.
vacios.habitos: Choose a habit to start walking with consistency.

onboarding.bienvenidaTexto: A space to walk with God each day, at your own pace.
onboarding.privacidadTexto: Your journal, prayers and notes are encrypted on this device before they leave it. Not even we can read them.
onboarding.habitosTexto: Choose the habits you want to grow. There are no streaks to lose and no reproach here.
onboarding.iaTexto: The AI helps you study the Bible and prepare devotionals. It never speaks for God and never replaces your pastor.
onboarding.iglesiaTexto: You can join your community for events and groups. Your private content stays private.
onboarding.crearCuentaTexto: Create your account to keep your spiritual history and restore it on any device.

autenticacion.contrasenaCorta: Your password needs at least 8 characters.

diario.descripcion: Whatever you write here is encrypted on your device before it leaves.
diario.campoCuerpo: What do you want to remember about today?
diario.ayudaEtiquetas: Separate them with commas. They're encrypted too.
diario.sinEntradas: You haven't written anything yet. It'll be here whenever you want.
diario.ilegibles_one: There is 1 entry this device can't open.
diario.ilegibles_other: There are {{count}} entries this device can't open.

errores.tituloVacio: Give it a title, even a short one.

oracion.descripcion: Your requests are encrypted on your device. So are the names.
oracion.campoTitulo: What do you want to pray about?
oracion.ayudaPersonas: Separate them with commas. They never leave your device unencrypted.
oracion.sinPeticiones: Your requests will live here. Write the first one whenever you want.
oracion.ilegibles_one: There is 1 request this device can't open.
oracion.ilegibles_other: There are {{count}} requests this device can't open.

errores.tituloVacio: Write what you want to pray about.
errores.tituloLargo: That's too long for a title.
errores.demasiadasPersonas: That's too many people for one request.
errores.avanceVacio: Write the update before saving it.

habitos.descripcion: Steadiness, at your own pace. Only what you do gets recorded here.
habitos.campoTitulo: What do you want to cultivate?
habitos.sinHabitos: Your habits will live here. Start with a small one.
habitos.ilegibles_one: There is 1 habit this device can't open.
habitos.ilegibles_other: There are {{count}} habits this device can't open.

errores.tituloVacio: Write what you want to cultivate.
errores.tituloLargo: That's too long for a title.

biblia.sinConexion: This chapter isn't downloaded and you're offline right now.
biblia.sinNotas: You haven't written anything about this chapter yet.
biblia.notaPrivada: Your notes are encrypted. The Bible text isn't yours and isn't stored with them.

errores.notaVacia: Write the note before saving it.

biblioteca.descripcion: Your journey, organised. Nothing is copied here: each card points to its original.
biblioteca.sinElementos: Once you write in your journal or save a prayer, it'll show up here.
biblioteca.ilegibles_one: There is 1 card this device can't open.
biblioteca.ilegibles_other: There are {{count}} cards this device can't open.
biblioteca.clasificacionLocal: Sorting happens on your device. The server doesn't know what any of this is about.

ia.descripcion: A companion, not an authority. It never speaks for God or replaces your church.
ia.campoMensaje: What would you like to talk about?
ia.sinConversaciones: Your conversations will show up here. They're private and encrypted.
ia.memoriaBorrada: Everything was erased. No copy remains.
ia.avisoEnvio: To reply, this conversation has to be sent to the provider. Nothing else is sent: not your journal, not your prayers, not your notes.
ia.crisis: What you're sharing matters, and you shouldn't carry it alone. Please talk to someone right now: call an emergency service in your country, or call or message someone you trust who can be with you today. If there's immediate danger, get medical help now. I can stay here with you, but I can't replace a person by your side, and nobody is reading this conversation.
ia.respaldo: I'd rather not answer that. I can walk with you through what the Bible says and help you think it over, but that decision is yours and belongs with the people who know you.
ia.sinConexion: I need a connection to reply. The rest of the app keeps working.

errores.sinAutorizacion: We need your permission to send this conversation.

ia.avisoCrisis: This needs a person, not an app.
ia.confirmarBorrado: Delete every conversation? This cannot be undone.
ia.sinMensajes: Write whatever you want. No one else reads it.

memorial.descripcion: What you have seen God do. Kept here so you can read it again.
memorial.sinMemoriales: You haven't written anything here yet. When you want to remember something that happened, this is where it goes.
memorial.ilegibles_one: There is {{count}} memorial this device cannot read.
memorial.ilegibles_other: There are {{count}} memorials this device cannot read.
memorial.campoRelato: Tell it in your own words
memorial.desdeOracion: It came from a prayer you marked as answered.

errores.tituloVacio: Write at least a few words about what happened.
